items.quote: She headed lean process reviews at the service centres, setting priorities for several teams.
She managed tracing how a delay in one agency rippled through to others for her unit.
Torko drove cross-agency collaboration on the joint taskforce for the whole division.
Torko Thalira handled delivery under pressure through a demanding year-end peak competently within her team.
She was recognised sector-wide for her leadership of dashboards tracking service performance metrics.
She spearheaded a ten-year outlook for where the agency should be heading at the national level.
